name: Lennox International Inc.
summary_en: Lennox International Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and markets products for the heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration markets in the United States, Canada, and internationally. The Home Comfort Solutions segment provides furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, packaged heating and cooling systems, indoor air quality equipment, comfort control products, and replacement parts and supplies; residential heating, ventilation, cooling equipment, and air conditioning; and evaporator coils, air handlers, and unit heaters under the Lennox, Dave Lennox Signature Collection, Armstrong Air, Ducane, AirEase, Concord, MagicPak, Advanced Distributor Products, Allied, Elite Series, Supco, Linebacker, Elite series, Merit Series, Comfort Sync, Healthy Climate, Healthy Climate Solutions, iComfort, ComfortSense, and Lennox Stores names. The Building Climate Solutions segment offers unitary heating and air conditioning equipment, controls, installation and service of commercial heating and cooling equipment, variable refrigerant flow commercial, curb, curb adapters, drop box diffusers, HVAC recycling, and salvage service. This segment also provides condensing units, unit coolers, fluid coolers, air cooled condensers, process chillers, compressorized racks, and replacement parts and supplies under the Lennox, Model L, CORE, Enlight, Xion, Energence, Prodigy, Strategos, Raider, Lennox VRF, Lennox National Account Services, Allied Commercial, Duro Dyne, Dyne-Tite, Durozone, Elite, AES Industries, Mechanical, Heatcraft Worldwide Refrigeration, Bohn, MAGNA, Larkin, Climate Control, Chandler Refrigeration, IntelliGen, and Interlink brands. The company also offers small package units, rooftop units, chillers, air handlers, and fan coils. It sells its products and services through direct sales, distributors, and company-owned parts and supplies stores. The company was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Richardson, Texas.
summary_ko: Lennox International Inc.는 자회사와 함께 미국, 캐나다 및 전 세계의 난방, 환기, 공조 및 냉동 시장용 제품을 설계, 제조 및 판매합니다. 홈 컴포트 솔루션 부문은 용광로, 에어컨, 열 펌프, 패키지형 난방 및 냉방 시스템, 실내 공기질 장비, 컴포트 제어 제품, 교체 부품 및 소모품을 제공합니다. 주거용 난방, 환기, 냉각 장비 및 에어컨; Lennox, Dave Lennox Signature Collection, Armstrong Air, Ducane, AirEase, Concord, MagicPak, Advanced Distributor Products, Allied, Elite Series, Supco, Linebacker, Elite 시리즈, Merit Series, Comfort Sync, Healthy Climate, Healthy Climate Solutions, iComfort, ComfortSense 및 Lennox Stores 이름의 증발기 코일, 공기 처리기 및 장치 히터. 건물 기후 솔루션 부문은 단일 난방 및 공조 장비, 상업용 난방 및 냉방 장비의 제어, 설치 및 서비스, 상업용 가변 냉매 흐름, 연석, 연석 어댑터, 드롭 박스 디퓨저, HVAC 재활용 및 회수 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 Lennox, Model L, CORE, Enlight, Xion, Energence, Prodigy, Strategos, Raider, Lennox VRF, Lennox National Account Services, Allied Commercial, Duro Dyne, Dyne-Tite, Durozone, Elite, AES Industries, Mechanical, Heatcraft Worldwide에 따라 응축 장치, 장치 냉각기, 유체 냉각기, 공냉식 응축기, 프로세스 냉각기, 압축 랙 및 교체 부품 및 공급품을 제공합니다. 냉동, Bohn, MAGNA, Larkin, Climate Control, Chandler Refrigeration, IntelliGen 및 Interlink 브랜드. 이 회사는 또한 소형 패키지 장치, 옥상 장치, 냉각기, 공기 처리기 및 팬 코일을 제공합니다. 직접 판매, 유통업체, 회사 소유 부품 및 소모품 매장을 통해 제품과 서비스를 판매합니다. 이 회사는 1895년에 설립되었으며 텍사스주 리처드슨에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
